name: com.25karats/storefront
title: 25karats — Made-to-Order Wedding & Engagement Rings
description: Search and price made-to-order rings, jewelry, and lab-grown diamonds from the 25karats catalog.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the 25karats made-to-order catalog (wedding bands, engagement rings, his & hers sets, fine jewelry) by keywords or a style code. Use this first when a shopper describes what they want ("braided mens wedding band", "vintage engagement ring"). Returns product cards with live starting prices in USD, image URLs, and product URLs. Follow up with get_product for options and price_product for an exact configured price. The query is keyword search only: put a budget in price_min/price_max, the kind of ring in category, and the metal in metal; prices or "under $X" written into query are ignored. total_count is exact unless capped is true; capped counts are lower bounds imposed by the search index.

query.description: Style keywords or a style code (e.g. 'braided', 'HC100232'). Not parsed for budget, category, or metal: pass those as price_min/price_max, category, and metal

category.description: Optional shopper-facing catalog category. engagement_rings / wedding_bands / his_hers_sets / jewelry select a product line; mens_rings and womens_diamond_rings select the site's men's (/wedding-rings/mens) and women's (/wedding-rings/womens) ring collections, which hold plain bands and diamond rings alike

product_line.description: Optional product-line filter; category is preferred

tags.description: Every supplied style tag must match, by slug, name, or id

metal.description: Optional metal filter; each returned starting price and URL use this metal's variant

limit.description: Requested results per page (default 10); values outside 1..24 are clamped and reported

page.description: Requested page; values below 1 are clamped and reported

tools.name: browse_collection
tools.description: Browse one collection/category page deterministically — the same product set, ordering, and filters a shopper sees on the site. Pass the collection permalink from list_collections (e.g. 'wedding-rings/womens/eternity'). Filter by style tags, metals, or sort; paginate 24 per page. Prefer search_products for free-text intent and this tool for "show me everything in X".

collection.description: Collection permalink, with or without leading slash

metals.description: Offered metal codes, e.g. ['14K','PLAT']; price and URL use the first offered selection

price_tag.description: Price-range slug or id, e.g. '501-1000'; accepts one value or an array

cats.description: Child-category slugs on a listing-nav collection; matches the site's cats filter

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The navigable catalog taxonomy: every public collection with its permalink (for browse_collection), title, and product count, as a tree. Call once to orient; results change rarely.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail for one product: metal variants with live starting prices, the complete customization matrix (ring sizes, widths, thickness, color, finish, stone type, engraving rules) with the ids to echo into price_product, stone specifications, physical dimensions, size-group siblings, matching pieces, and the default image. Identify the product by exactly one of slug, style_code, or url (any 25karats product URL works).

style_code.description: Style/SKU code shown on the product page, e.g. 'HC100232'

tools.name: price_product
tools.description: Exact live price in USD for a fully configured item — the same number the customer pays on 25karats.com (computed from current metal market pricing, not a cached feed price). Identify the item by variant_id (from get_product) or style_code, optionally with metal. For wedding bands pass ring_size/width/thickness/color/finish (option_value ids or display values from get_product); for his & hers sets pass his/her objects with those keys; for engagement rings pass stone_type and ring_size. Unset axes use the product's defaults. Band and set prices depend on ring size: without ring_size the quote is provisional (it assumes a size, often the smallest and cheapest), so ask the shopper's size first. Returns the price, the resolved configuration, and a deep_link_url that opens the product page pre-configured for checkout, engraving included (the shopper should check the pre-filled engraving on the page). Invalid values return the list of valid ones — correct and retry. Any option group can also be set through the options object keyed by the option_id values returned by get_product (the only way to configure generic jewelry). His & hers options and engraving belong inside the respective his/her object. Inputs that do not apply to the item (stone_type on a band, top-level ring_size on a set) are rejected with the inputs that do; settings sold without a center stone say so in configuration and notes.

variant_id.description: Variant id from get_product (preferred). Any style_code, slug, or url passed with it must name the same item

stone_type.description: Engagement rings with a diamond-type choice: 'natural' or 'lab' (or the id from get_product). Rejected on settings sold without a center stone (get_product shows stone_types: [] and setting_only: true)

width.description: Bands: option_value id or display value, e.g. '6' (mm)

options.description: Map option_id (from get_product) to an option_value id or display label; an alternative to the named axes for any customizable item
Map option_id (from get_product) to an option_value id or display label; an alternative to the named axes for any customizable item

his.description: His & hers sets: configuration and optional engraving for the his band

options.description: Map option_id (from get_product) to an option_value id or display label; an alternative to the named axes for any customizable item

her.description: His & hers sets: configuration and optional engraving for the her band

engraving_text.description: Wedding bands only; for H&H put this inside his/her

engraving_font.description: Wedding bands only; for H&H put this inside his/her

tools.name: get_product_images
tools.description: Every gallery image for a product with high-resolution URLs. Each image lists only renditions that actually exist, largest first — modern photography is 2048x2048 WebP at the 'original' size — plus the metal tone, band width, and finish the photo shows, and descriptive alt text. Identify the product by exactly one of slug, style_code, or url. Pass metal to order the gallery for that metal: the photo that best shows it comes first, and matches_selected_metal says which photos show it.

metal_tone.description: Optionally return only photos showing this metal tone

tools.name: search_diamonds
tools.description: Search 25karats' in-stock IGI/GIA-certified lab-grown loose diamonds (center stones for engagement rings) by shape, carat, color, clarity, cut, and price. Values outside the grading scales (an unknown shape, color, clarity, grade, or lab, or a min above its max) return an error listing the accepted values; an empty result means no stones match. Prices are the live customer price in USD. Each stone includes certificate details, measurements, and image/video links when available. The site has no pairing step: the shopper adds the stone and a ring setting to the cart separately, and calls 800-201-3404 to confirm the stone fits the setting.

shape.description: One shape or an array: Round, Princess, Emerald, Marquise, Asscher, Oval, Pear, Heart, Cushion, Radiant

color.description: One color or an array; D through K

clarity.description: One clarity or an array: FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, SI1, SI2, I1, I2, I3

cut.description: Cut grade as a label or certificate code: 'Ideal' (ID) or 'Excellent' (EX)

polish.description: Polish grade as a label or certificate code: 'Excellent' (EX), 'Very Good' (VG), 'Good' (GD)

symmetry.description: Symmetry grade as a label or certificate code: 'Excellent' (EX) or 'Very Good' (VG)

lab.description: Grading lab: IGI, GIA, GCAL, HRD, or AGS

stock_no.description: Exact stone lookup by stock number

limit.description: Results per page (default 24); values outside 1..50 are clamped and reported

page.description: Page number; values below 1 are clamped and reported

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: 25karats brand facts and policies for answering shoppers: who we are, shipping and production times, returns, warranty, resizing, engraving, financing, and contact details. Call this before answering policy questions rather than guessing.
